Gold Guide

Understand Gold Purity

Understanding karat helps you compare gold prices and choose jewellery according to purity and intended use.

99.9% Pure

24 Karat

Very high-purity gold commonly used as a fine-gold reference.

91.6% Pure

22 Karat

High-gold-content purity commonly used in traditional jewellery.

87.5% Pure

21 Karat

A commonly discussed jewellery purity in Pakistan.

75% Pure

18 Karat

Lower-karat gold with a higher proportion of alloy metals.

✦ Always confirm purity and weight before purchase. ✦
